sourceText: Strictly continue Story 6 until all bounded waves are implemented and DONE; eliminate repeated REVIEW rounds by mechanically validating the final acceptance topology and executable evidence before REVIEW.
normalizedOutcome: Before any reviewer round, the user can run pre_review_check and see a deterministic PASS only when the current worktree reconciles planned-to-actual paths and has fresh admissible executable, mutation and transcript proof; an omitted basis-backed topology path produces AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF and blocks DEV-to-REVIEW in enforce mode.
acceptanceClaim: The production pre_review_check and DEV-to-REVIEW consumer share a signed current verifier result, pass the real chain, reject omission/stale/tamper/weak-authority mutations, restore cleanly, and add no Wave 3A or Wave 4 behavior.
